# Set for runtime‑added prefixes (e.g., from user code or env vars)
_EXTRA_KNOWN_LLM_INSTRUMENTATION_SCOPE_PREFIXES: set[str] = set()

def add_extra_llm_instrumentation_scopes(prefixes: list[str] | set[str]) -> None:
    """Add extra instrumentation scope prefixes to be treated as known LLM instrumentors.

    This allows users to register custom instrumentation namespaces that should be
    exported by default alongside the built‑in list.
    """
    _EXTRA_KNOWN_LLM_INSTRUMENTATION_SCOPE_PREFIXES.update(prefixes)
